title: JSON Schema for Generic Synthesis Patcher (GSP) configuration files
description: An array of GSP rules / groups.

debug.description: Enable debugging on this rule / group. If group will only debug the group's filters, use debug on child rules to also enable debug there.

priority.description: Rules are applied in accending priority order. If multiple rules have same priority order is random.

types.description: Type(s) that this rule applies to.

recordTypes.description: Case-insensitive synonym for types. If both are supplied their values are unioned.

masters.description: List of mod names where record must originate from.

!masters.description: List of mod names where record must not originate from.

patchedBy.description: List of mod names where record must of been patched by. Will not match record's master mod.

!patchedBy.description: List of mod names where record must not of been patched by. Will not match record's master mod.

^patchedBy.description: List of mod names where record must of been patched by equaly one of the listed mods. Will not match record's master mod.

&patchedBy.description: List of mod names where record must of been patched by all of the listed mods. Will not match record's master mod.

patched.description: Check if any property of a record has already been patched by another rule or not. Use null to ignore patched state.

allOf.$comment: Only allow either masters, !masters or neither, never both.

oneOf.errorMessage: Can only use one of the following patchedBy, !patchedBy, ^patchedBy or &patchedBy.

oneOf.$comment: Allow not having any of the patchedBy properties

editorID.description: List of Editor IDs to match against this rule. May be regular expression.

!editorID.description: List of Editor IDs to exclude from this rule. May be regular expression.

formID.description: List of Form IDs to match against this rule.

!formID.description: List of Form IDs to exclude from this rule.

onlyIfDefault.description: Filter only records that property action is targeting, is currently set to original value from master record.

matches.description: Extra filter based on supported property matches.

fill.description: On matched records fill listed properties with provided value.

forward.description: Forward record data. Plugin.esp: [] forwards all eligible fields. Field: [] in field-indexed mode selects all enabled sources. All: [] copies the complete winning record as an override, including master-only records, with implicit load-order sorting. All must be the only Forward key; only Default, Sort and IndexedByField options are accepted, and OnlyIfDefault must be false. Explicit All source arrays accept plugin inclusions or !Plugin.esp exclusions, not both.

merge.description: On matched records, merge listed field values across instances of the same record.

allOf.$comment: Only allow either editorID, !editorID or neither, never both.
Only allow either formID, !formID or neither, never both.

items.errorMessage: Priority cannot be set on rules belonging to a group

deepCopyIn.description: Use Mutagen's DeepCopyIn calls to copy value(s) from either previous instances of same record or provided record.

fromID.description: Copy from this record. FormID or EditorID can be used, or leave as null to copy from previous instance of current record. Record must be of the same type as destination.

fromMod.description: Copy from record in this mod. If multiple mods provided, will be selected based on forwardOptions. If fromID provided and this is null, will copy from the winning version.

mask.description: Translation mask which determines what properties to copy. If no fromID set, default mask will copy all properties.

anyOf.errorMessage: Must provide at least fromID and/or fromMod

recordType.description: A case- and separator-insensitive record selector. Game schemas suggest known Mutagen names, GSP names, signatures, and aliases; runtime preflight validates the final value.
